## Summary
Soham Sawalakhe (Soham Manish Sawalakhe) is a Software Developer, AI/ML Engineer, and Computer Engineering student based in Amravati, Maharashtra, India. He works as a Backend Developer at SitaraHub and has published research in Scopus-indexed international journals.

## Key Projects

### 1. Covert Database Detection (AI/ML & Security)
- **Technologies**: Python, Tkinter, Scikit-learn, Stegano, Cryptography
- **Description**: Desktop application to detect hidden databases using steganography, cryptography, and machine learning. Achieved 90% detection accuracy. Published in a Scopus-indexed journal.
- **Link**: https://github.com/SohamSawalakhe/Covert-Database-Detection

### 2. Library Management System (Full Stack)
- **Technologies**: Django, Django REST Framework, MySQL, Bootstrap
- **Description**: Dual-interface management system with role-based access control, JWT authentication, and automated book issue/return tracking.
- **Link**: https://github.com/SohamSawalakhe/Library-Management-System

### 3. Immersive 3D Developer Portfolio
- **Technologies**: React, Three.js, Vite, TypeScript, WebGL, Framer Motion
- **Website**: https://sohamsawalakhe.space/
- **Description**: Interactive WebGL portfolio with responsive scrollytelling, custom shaders, and particle dynamics.
